messages:
Priya (Product): quick thread to lock pricing around reserved slots and onboarding credits before partner review tomorrow. short list: slot pricing, onboarding credit format, trial soft caps, and EU rollout note.
Noah (Finance): for speed: propose slot = $275/month base + $0.18/slot-hour. onboarding credit = one-time USD credit applied within first invoice. keep discounts simple: annual = 18% off list.
Ruth (Sales): field feedback: customers want an explicit "launch runway" (30-day burst) for first production launch. prefer it as a named artifact in the contract so AE can point to it. also, show one worked dollar example per tier.
Gabe (Legal): contract language suggestion for runway: "Launch Runway: during the initial 30 days after production provisioning, customer may exceed committed usage; Provider will bill at list rates and will review requests for discretionary credits within 60 days; no guaranteed refunds." keeps legal exposure manageable.
Ivy (Eng): note: reserving slots in control plane requires pre-warmed pools which adds cost in non-billable hours. regionally gated: US-EAST ready, EU available next quarter. call out in docs.
PriceBot: billing-config: slot-pricing v1.4 applied to staging 2026-03-21T16:20:04Z - CI#4902 :white_check_mark:
Priya (Product): draft tier shape: Core (metered, trial softcap 10M tokens), Business (includes 1 slot + 50M runway, quarterly/annual), Enterprise (custom slots, SLA, 24/7). Priority-routing = per-slot add-on across tiers.
Noah (Finance): gating for GA: 2 pilots on Business/Enterprise >= $50k ARR combined, end-to-end billing tests, and <3% margin erosion estimate.
Ruth (Sales): lining up pilots with FlexApp and Metricly. will push Business quarterly to avoid long legal cycles.
Gabe (Legal): I'll add the Launch Runway clause and downsize notice (30 days for annual) to the term sheet and post redlines by 1700.
Ivy (Eng): I'll add a region flag and perf test for reserved slots in the release checklist. ETA EOD.
Priya (Product): decision: publish three tiers, price slots as per Noah, onboard credit in USD applied to first invoice, 30-day Launch Runway with discretionary credit review. I'll update deck and share at 15:45. objections?
Noah (Finance): none. include a sample invoice example.
Ruth (Sales): 44d will draft customer one-pager after deck.
